messages:
Ellen: Quick morning note  Comet8p5-int4 overnight smoke finished. Produced an EconPulseScore for quick routing decisions.
Marcus: paste the topline pls
Ellen: pasted from the runner below:
```
model: Comet8p5-int4
cost_per_1k_tokens: $0.55
baseline_cost_per_1k (comet8p5-fp16): $1.60
cost_savings_pct: 65.6%
overall_quality_delta: -0.9pp (avg chat-summary + intent)
longdoc_recall_delta: -2.7pp (multi-hop QA)
hallucination_delta: +0.5pp (on recall slice)
p95_latency_short: 200ms
p95_latency_long_cold: 340ms
EconPulseScore: 0.84   # 0..1 higher better; weights cost:0.5 quality:0.4 latency:0.1
```
Rhea: 0.84 is compelling for a lot of consumer flows. But recall +2.7pp and hallucination +0.5pp on multi-hop is non-trivial for GTN/legal.
Kai: Ops observations: KV cache miss rate on long-docs was 20% during cold runs; warmstart reduces p95 by ~65ms in local repros. GPU utilization healthy (0.66 avg).
Marcus: Proposed rollout: create a hybrid flag `comet.int4.hybrid.v1` with default split 0.60 and holdbacks ["gtn_core", "payments_validate"]. Probe plan for GTN: 2% sample after priming fixes and human micro-eval pass.
Ellen: Remediation experiments: P-A anchor-priming, P-B explicit citation anchors, P-C warmstart + prefix caching. Running each on 2k samples; will post results by EOD.
Rhea: Safety/regression: fuzz suite had no blocker hits but hallucination regex flagged ~1% more examples on recall slice. Recommend holding GTN until micro-eval shows <1.0pp gap.
Kai: Infra thresholds: auto-fallback to baseline if any holdback slice delta >1.25pp sustained for 10m OR EconPulseScore drops <0.72. I'll implement the flag + emergency policy tonight. Name: comet.hybrid.canary.2026-03-23
Marcus: Add observability: alert if long-doc KV miss rate > 18% or p95_long_cold increases >50ms in 15m window.
Ellen: I'll update the scorecard with EconPulseScore breakdown and upload the CSV. Will also attach sample prompts that fail recall.
Marcus: Micro-eval plan: 250 GTN prompts, human ratings, target <1.0pp gap. Also 150 legal prompts with higher bar (<0.6pp). If pass, we expand GTN probe to 5% then 20% staged.
deploy-bot: smoke-run finished: 6329998888 -> 6329998800. Artifacts uploaded to /bench/artifacts/6329998888. KV miss rate snapshot: 20%.
Rhea: Owners: Ellen (priming experiments + scorecard), Kai (routing flag + infra fallback + alerts), Marcus (PM comms + micro-eval coordination).
Ellen: TL;DR for PMs: Comet int4 yields ~66% token cost reduction, small avg quality hit (~0.9pp), but multi-hop long-doc recall regressions and a small hallucination uptick. Recommendation: hybrid routing with holdbacks + priming and micro-eval before shifting GTN/regulatory traffic.
Marcus: I'll loop in product and legal and schedule a 15m sync. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
